head: 9296aff
verdict: TARGETS EXIST — with 2 premise corrections (one FALSE hook claim, one unbuilt dependency)
summary: All reuse surfaces for P3 exist in real code. Two corrections vs the task brief: (1) AdaptiveOpponent.pickMove does NOT return eval cp (returns a uci string|null); eval cp is obtained from EngineClient.evaluate(fen).whiteCp. (2) The F6 controller (src/game/gameSession.ts) is DRAFTED (V1 spec) but NOT BUILT — it does not exist on disk. P3 must be spec'd against the F6 contract with F6 declared a hard prerequisite; the Play.svelte hooks are the concrete fallback surface and the today-state for honesty framing.

clampElo.note: clamps to [ELO_MIN=1320, ELO_MAX=3190]; takes arbitrary Elo — offset/override is a clampElo(targetElo + delta) call.

applyStrength.note: reads this.state.targetElo and sets UCI_LimitStrength + UCI_Elo + UCI_Chess960. Serialized via applyOptions (audit L8). Setting an override = mutate state.targetElo then applyStrength().

rollingWinRate.note: draws count 0.5; empty defaults to TARGET_WINRATE=0.55.

pickMove.returns: Promise<string | null>  (uci bestmove, NOT eval cp)
pickMove.premise_correction: Task said 'pickMove returns eval cp' — FALSE. It returns res.bestmove (uci). Eval cp comes from engine.evaluate(fen,{...}).whiteCp (white-POV cp, used today in coachEvalBad) or analyzeLines(...).whiteCp.

pickHumanMove.note: MultiPV-3 temperature sampling; anti-blunder gap 150cp; falls back to pickMove. Math.random is the only impurity (sampleHumanMove takes injected rand).

recordGame.note: pure; folds an outcome into OpponentState, nudges targetElo toward 55% band, step 50-100cp.

applyGameResult.note: pure; caller assigns results back. P3 adaptation-feedback line is derived from nextOpp.targetElo vs prevOpp.targetElo.

botMovetime.note: clock-aware bot budget, clamped per category. PLt 'increment-in-movetime' folds here (currently increment is NOT added to the per-move budget).

finishGame.note: idempotent via gameFinished guard (audit W6); folds rating via applyGameResult, persists GameRecord. resign() calls finishGame('loss') (line 500); a draw path would call finishGame('draw').

resign.note: sets status='over', stops clock, result=youResigned, finishGame('loss'). P3 adds bot-resign (bot triggers finishGame('win')) + draw (finishGame('draw')).

ratingLine.note: shows pool rating + bot Elo. P3 adaptation-feedback line sits adjacent to this post-game.

opponentStyleSelect.note: human|engine <select>; bound to app.settings.opponentStyle via setOpponentStyle(). P3 difficulty-mode <select> mirrors this control + persistence pattern.

coachEvalBad.note: PLt difficulty-scaled coached-blunder threshold folds here: scale the 250cp gate by the active difficulty/bot-Elo.

engineMove.note: where the bot's reply is computed; bot-resign/draw decision is evaluated here (or in the F6 controller's engineReply) AFTER the bot would move, using a full-strength eval.

checkEnd.note: wraps game.terminal(); P3 draw-by-agreement is a NON-terminal end the controller must surface separately (game is not over by rules).

SettingsRecord.note: has opponentStyle?, metacogEnabled?, locale? — additive-optional pattern. P3 difficulty mode persists here as an additive optional field (no DB_VERSION bump).

GameRecord.note: has coached:boolean, variant?, startFen?. P3 'override game flag' (Q-E: a Fixed/Easier/Harder game does NOT move the adaptive pool) persists here as an additive optional field e.g. difficultyMode?.

src/store/db.ts.policy: additive optional field + schemaRev bump, backfilled in load path — NO DB_VERSION bump (db.ts:121-125).

evaluate.note: whiteCp is the honest eval signal for bot-resign/draw. MUST pass fullStrength:true so a sticky throttled UCI_Elo doesn't corrupt the resign decision (C-1/P0-01).

analyzeLines.note: alternative source; pickHumanMove already uses it.

src/ui/ConfirmDialog.svelte.note: reusable NON-BLOCKING dialog with danger flag; already used for coached take-back. Reused for draw-offer / accept-draw UI (P3) and confirm-resign (P2 owns confirm-resign).

terminal.note: returns {over,reason,winner}; reasons threefold|fiftyMove|insufficient|stalemate|checkmate. Draw-by-agreement is NOT a terminal reason — P3 surfaces it as a distinct agreed-draw end.

dependency_F6.evidence: src/game/gameSession.ts and gameSession.test.ts do NOT exist; grep createGameSession|GameSession across src/ = 0 matches.
dependency_F6.contract_for_P3: F6 controller accepts startFen + config { humanMove?, retry?, bookMove?, movetime? } (opt-in); return-state API; NO auto-chain (applyPlayerMove and engineReply are separate steps); checkTerminal is a pure idempotent query returning {over,reason,winner,outcome} — NEVER a localized string (AP-CTRL-1).
dependency_F6.implication: P3 is a CONSUMER of the F6 controller (architecture §3 lists P3 dep = F6). P3 spec targets the F6 contract: bot-resign/draw + difficulty live as new controller config/queries; Play wires them. If P3 builds before F6 lands, the same logic targets Play.svelte's engineMove/finishGame directly (fallback). Spec must declare F6 a hard prerequisite and frame today-state honestly.
